source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital payments" OR "digital payment" OR cashless OR demonetisation OR demonetization
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital payments" OR "digital payment" OR cashless OR demonetisation OR demonetization,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital payment" OR "digital payments" OR "cashless" OR "demonetisation" OR "demonetization")
